dct_description_sm: The data were collected as part of the ArcticNet project titled Permafrost and Climate Change in Northern Coastal Canada. The snow measurements were collected in order to validate remote sensing algorithms to retrieve snow depth and density. The main purpose was to capture the spatial variability of snow characteristics over various terrain types representing the spatial heterogeneity of the subarctic environment.
dct_title_s: Snowpack Measurements in Umiujaq area (Nunavik, Canada)
